🌹🇲🇽 PENSIÓN MUJERES BIENESTAR — 56,969 MILLION PESOS FOR 2026, RECOGNIZING THE LABOR NEOLIBERALISM REFUSED TO COUNT

The federal government's Pensión Mujeres Bienestar will receive a social investment of 56,969 million pesos in 2026 — direct cash transfers, no intermediaries, no NGO middlemen taking their cut.

Why it matters: the program puts a peso value on decades of women's unpaid care work — the labor that the neoliberal model needed to function but refused to recognize on any balance sheet. The Bienestar logic flips that: economic autonomy as a right, not a favor.

Almost 57 billion pesos. Universal. Direct. That's what state policy with a working-class compass looks like.

Source: Contralínea

🚨🇲🇽 SOFT COUP, NOW WITH STADIUM LIGHTING — ALCALDE MAPS THE TRANSNATIONAL DISINFO ECOSYSTEM TARGETING SHEINBAUM

Presidential Legal Counsel Luisa María Alcalde laid out the architecture of right-wing destabilization running parallel to the FIFA World Cup: "no es una suma de esfuerzos aislados, sino un ecosistema estructurado y transnacional de injerencia."

Named operators include Argentine Fernando Cerimedo (founder of La Derecha Diario, implicated in Brazilian election disinformation) and Spaniard Javier Negre (convicted in Spanish courts for fabricating false news). Coordinated bot networks, "failed state" and "narco-government" framings, and a five-phase soft-coup model running cognitive warfare and lawfare in parallel.

The Mundial is the cover. The target is the Cuarta Transformación.

Source: Contralínea

🔥🇲🇽 EX-SAT OFFICIAL JAILED FOR ILLICIT ENRICHMENT — 15M-PESO HOUSE LAUNDERED THROUGH A FAKE "SERVICE" CONTRACT

Héctor Taurino Landa Cabrera, former central administrator of Strategic Coordination for the SAT's Large Taxpayers division (2011–2018), was detained in Xalapa, Veracruz, for illicit enrichment.

The setup: leasing company Arrendadora Franllutti allegedly handed him a residence valued at more than 15 million pesos — dressed up as payment for a service contract that was never actually performed.

A central administrator. Large Taxpayers. The exact node where neoliberal Mexico's biggest fortunes met the tax authority. The 4T anti-corruption push is reaching back into the Peña-era SAT — and pulling.

Source: La Jornada

🇲🇽🇵🇸 "EXPULSEN A ISRAEL DE LA FIFA" — PROTESTERS DROP BANNER OVER WORLD CUP LOGO IN TORONTO

Hours before Canada's World Cup debut, demonstrators in "Jews for a Free Palestine" shirts climbed an embankment above the Gardiner Expressway — one of Canada's busiest highways — and unfurled a massive red banner reading "Echen a Israel de la FIFA" directly over the tournament's official logo.

The protesters openly accused FIFA of applying a double standard: the institution moved within days to suspend Russia in 2022, but has refused to take any equivalent action against Israel through the entire Gaza genocide.

That's the whole indictment in one banner.

Source: La Jornada

🇲🇽🛢️ <u>PEMEX CEO HEADS TO BRASIL: SOUTH-SOUTH ENERGY ALLIANCE GOES OPERATIONAL</u>

Pemex director Juan Carlos Carpio travels to Brasil this month to sign confidentiality agreements and memorandums of understanding with Petrobras — joint studies for offshore exploration in the Mexican Gulf, plus production and refining cooperation.

The Sheinbaum-Lula follow-up. Two state oil giants from the global south uniting while private vultures circle Pemex's ~$80 billion debt load.

Bioenergy alternatives also on the table. Petrobras brings 2006 presalt deepwater expertise; Pemex brings the Gulf basin.

Reported by El Financiero / Bloomberg.

Source: infobae.com

🇲🇽🏭 <u>HOSPITAL XOCO: "MOST MODERN EMERGENCY UNIT IN LATIN AMERICA" — FOR THE UNINSURED</u>

CDMX head Clara Brugada and IMSS-Bienestar director Alejandro Svarch inaugurated a fully digitalized emergency department at Hospital General Xoco: intelligent operating room, shock/trauma room for critical patients, portable CT scanner described as "unique in Latin America."

The hospital treats 44,000+ patients a year — all uninsured residents of Mexico City. 25 new ambulances were already added to the CDMX fleet.

"Invertir en salud pública es salvar vidas y garantizar que la gente reciba la mejor atención posible," said Brugada.

Source: regeneracion.mx

🚨🇲🇽 <u>"ACÁ SÍ HAY MUCHA PASIÓN POR EL FUTBOL": ZÓCALO PACKED FOR WORLD CUP OPENING</u>

While the right predicted "chaos" at the World Cup opening, a Colombian fan summed up the actual scene at the Zócalo Fan Fest: "Acá sí hay mucha pasión por el futbol, muchos mexicanos apasionados, todo muy patriótico."

Thousands packed Mexico City's main plaza — green, white, red, mariachi hats, máscaras de luchador, matracas — for Mexico's 2-0 win over South Africa. CDMX confirmed Fan Fest at 9am; lines built fast around the historic center.

The doom narrative met the actual country.

Source: contralinea.com.mx

🇲🇽🌎 <u>SIX UNIVERSAL BIENESTAR PROGRAMS — DIRECT DEPOSIT, NO INTERMEDIARIES</u>

While Washington Republicans cut SNAP and gut Medicaid, Mexico's Secretaría de Bienestar runs six universal programs in parallel: Pensión Mujeres Bienestar (60-64), elderly pension, disability pension, Salud Casa por Casa, working mothers support, Sembrando Vida.

The stated framework: "garantizar los derechos sociales, reducir desigualdades y fortalecer la inclusión" of historically marginalized populations through direct economic support, medical attention, and productive projects.

Constitutional rights, paid directly, no intermediaries.

Source: contralinea.com.mx

🚨🇲🇽 <u>SHEINBAUM TO CNTE LEADERSHIP: "¿QUÉ CASO TIENE?" — GOES STRAIGHT TO RANK AND FILE</u>

After CNTE leaders kept presenting the same maximalist demands at every Segob and SEP meeting, Sheinbaum drew the line: "Diálogo con la CNTE, ¿qué caso tiene?"

Starting in August, the government will hold a national consultation directly with teachers — "escuela por escuela, maestro por maestro" — on Usicamm reform, bypassing the union bosses entirely.

Government has already met CNTE seven hours; advances on ISSSTE 2007 reform reversal are real. But leadership refuses to move. So Sheinbaum is moving without them.

Source: jornada.com.mx

🇲🇽🛢️ <u>SIN CFE NO HABRÍA SOBERANÍA: SHEINBAUM INAUGURA PLANTA 357MW EN MANZANILLO</u>

Sheinbaum cut the ribbon today on a new CFE combined-cycle plant in Manzanillo, Colima — 357MW added, bringing the Manzanillo complex to 2,860MW for 800,000 users across western Mexico.

"Sin la Comisión Federal de Electricidad no habría soberanía energética y no habría soberanía nacional," she said, recalling years of fighting CFE privatization.

Under AMLO, public-sector electrical generation went from minority status to 54%. The current plan: add 28,000MW more this sexenio. Four CFE plants already inaugurated this term in SLP, Querétaro, Yucatán and Guanajuato.

Source: jornada.com.mx
